mapper.select: select tr.id as id, tr.org_id as orgId, tr.patient_id as patientId, tr.appointment_id as appointmentId, tr.registered_id as registeredId, tr.dentist_id as dentistId, tr.type as firstVisit, tr.status as status, DATE_FORMAT(tr.crt_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as treatDate, DATE_FORMAT(tr.treat_start_time, '%H:%i') as treatStartTime, DATE_FORMAT(tr.treat_end_time, '%H:%i') as treatEndTime, tr.medical_record_completed as medicalRecordCompleted, tr.remarks, tr.inservice from treatment_record tr where tr.id = #{id}

select tr.id, tr.dentist_id as dentistId, tr.patient_id as patientId, r.first_visit as firstVisit, tr.treat_start_time as treatStarTime from treatment_record tr left join registered r on tr.registered_id = r.id where date_format(tr.treat_start_time,'%Y-%m-%d') = date_format(#{currentDate},'%Y-%m-%d') and tr.inservice = 1 and tr.status = #{status} and tr.org_id = #{orgId}
